summary: Rithm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a private offering of $500 million in senior unsecured notes due 2031. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, possibly including debt repayment. The notes are offered to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offering is unregistered and lacks exchange or registration rights. Structurally, this is a debt capital raising, not a return of capital; classification as a capital return is tentative. Watch for pricing terms and use of proceeds allocation.
